blogPost.title: Similar rule was implemented in The Netherlands 3 months ago. It means you have to upload a screenshot of your wallet/address before you can withdraw btc. Useless legislation for fighting terrorists & m.laundering of course, just annoying for users and lot of admin for exchanges. https://t.co/TLlUzxbJHA
blogPost.author: PlanB

sharedContent.title:
FinCEN has proposed a new rule extending AML regulation to "unhosted wallets."

If adopted, the rule would require regulated companies to verify the name & address of non-custodial wallet users for any transaction > $3k.

Public comments are due January 4.
https://t.co/RjqHcI1YpB
sharedContent.author: Jake Chervinsky

localize.full_text: 荷兰在3个月前也实施了类似的规定。这意味着您必须上传钱包/地址的截图，然后才能提取BTC。打击恐怖分子和洗钱的立法毫无用处，当然，这只会让用户感到恼火，也会给交易所带来很多管理费用。https://t.co/TLlUzxbJHA
localize.quoted_status_full_text:
FinCEN提出了一项新规则，将AML监管扩展到“非托管钱包”。

如果该规则被采纳，将要求受监管的公司在任何交易中核实非托管钱包用户的姓名和地址，金额为3000美元。

公众意见截止日期为1月4日。
https://t.co/RjqHcI1YpB

localize.full_text: 荷蘭在3個月前也實施了類似的規定。這意味着您必須上傳錢包/地址的截圖，然後才能提取BTC。打擊恐怖分子和洗錢的立法毫無用處，當然，這隻會讓用戶感到惱火，也會給交易所帶來很多管理費用。https://t.co/TLlUzxbJHA
localize.quoted_status_full_text:
FinCEN提出了一項新規則，將AML監管擴展到“非託管錢包”。

如果該規則被採納，將要求受監管的公司在任何交易中核實非託管錢包用戶的姓名和地址，金額爲3000美元。

公衆意見截止日期爲1月4日。
https://t.co/RjqHcI1YpB
